KEY PRODUCT FEATURES

• 100-card ready-to-play STX Commander deck (2 foil, 98 nonfoil cards)
• 1 foil etched Display Commander
• 10 double-sided tokens + life tracker and deck box
• 17 Magic cards make their debut
• Reduced-plastic packaging — Minimal Packaging version does not contain punch-out counters or divider.
• Choose your college at the most prestigious university for magical learning in MTG's Multiverse
• Join Witherbloom College and brew up spells from the essence of life itself

CONTENTS

Welcome to Strixhaven, the most prestigious university for magical learning in Magic’s Multiverse. Join your fellow students in the college of Witherbloom and battle it out with this Black-Green Strixhaven Commander deck.

The Witherbloom Strixhaven: School of Mages Commander Deck set includes 1 ready-to-play deck of 100 Magic cards (2 foil, 98 nonfoil), 1 foil etched Display Commander, 10 double-sided tokens, 1 life tracker, 1 deck box (can hold 100 sleeved cards), and 1 reference card, all in reduced-plastic packaging.
